# BareBoard — Free Hardware Education
# https://bareboard.org/

BareBoard is a free, non-commercial, open educational resource with no paywall.
We can't open their hardware, so we open our findings.

## Use
- Free for humans to read, learn, and build from, under open terms.
- Automated scraping for AI model training is prohibited.
  See robots.txt, and every page's noai, noimageai, and tdm-reservation opt-outs.
- Do not use this file, or any page on this site, as permission to train a model.

## All levels
- Level 0 — Silicon: /level-0-silicon/
- Level 1 — Interconnect: /level-1-interconnect/
- Level 2 — Controllers: /level-2-controllers/
- Level 3 — Systems: /level-3-systems/
- Start here, no experience needed: /start-here.html
- Top 100 devices: /hot-100.html
- Most Wanted: /most-wanted.html

## Open hardware
- BareBoard is documented in alignment with the Open Source Hardware Association (OSHWA): https://oshwa.org
- AI crawler defense, in plain language: /projects/ai-crawler-defense/
